capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned ethereum block 26197000 (hash 0x7f8f6377ac8f3948e1ac61d81c1a236b58c7ef57ef2743f18189cca1127aa66d). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Inherited controls concern rlusd-ripple, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14. The current adapter burnShares path realizes a loss only after its separately pinned 259200-second timelock; this is not an arbitrary share mint.
